name: tier-typo
scenario: The user says: "there's a typo in README.md around line 40 — 'recieve' should be 'receive'. fix it."

checks.why: classifies the typo as the lowest tier
no plan / spec / state file / subagents for a one-word fix

rubric: PASS if the response treats this as a trivial change: it makes (or says it will make) the single edit and verifies it, and does NOT open a plan, a spec document, an .overpower state file, or dispatch subagents. FAIL if it starts any multi-step planning ceremony for a typo.
